name: Centru de date Parcul Industrial Mures (Platforma Vidrasau)
developer: Consiliul Judetean Mures / Parc Industrial Mures SA
notes: County council preparing construction of a modern data center on the Vidrasau platform of the Mures Industrial Park (Ungheni, near Targu Mures airport); ~240m lei estimate per methodology. Planned stage (pre-construction).

name: TAZ IT Targu Mures datacenter
notes: Operator statement per country methodology (EU/government/company-funded datacenter project in Targu Mures); operator page not re-fetched in this run - unverified lead.

name: INVITE Systems Ploiesti data center
notes: Operator page confirms two facilities (Bucuresti + Ploiesti, Str. Elipsei 1); Ploiesti built as first modular Tier-3 data center in Romania, disaster-recovery/backup role >60 km from Bucharest. Operational.

name: Centrul de Date Regional Sud-Muntenia (STS-led)
developer: STS (lider) cu Consiliile Judetene Sud-Muntenia (Arges, Calarasi, Dambovita, Giurgiu, Ialomita, Prahova, Teleorman)
notes: Prahova County Council issued project-start comunicat; STS-led strategic regional data center, >EUR 47m, SMIS 342697, Regional Program Sud-Muntenia 2021-2027. Per methodology the physical facility is tracked in Prahova/Ploiesti; partner counties are service beneficiaries, not separate facilities.

name: STS CDS II Sibiu / node CPG Sibiu (Tier III)
notes: STS essential IT services center (CDS II) in Sibiu, Uptime-certified; ADR interview (Dragos Vlad) confirms Sibiu CPG node Tier III operational among 3 of 4 government-cloud nodes in service.

name: Tenaris Silcotub data centres Zalau (2 facilitati)
notes: Enterprise/institutional data centers at Tenaris Silcotub Zalau site; modernized/re-technologized by Datanet Systems Cluj. Operational enterprise facilities, not colocation.

name: DANUBIUS-RO Murighiol (International Centre for Advanced Studies on River-Sea Systems) - data center component
notes: EUR 128m DANUBIUS-RO research centre at Murighiol (Tulcea) includes data-center/ICT component; construction contract signed (approved stage). Research/public infrastructure, not commercial colo.

name: Cloud Privat Guvernamental - node Timisoara/Giroc (Tier IV)
notes: ADR (Dragos Vlad) states 3 of 4 CPG nodes operational (Sibiu/Brasov Tier III, Bucuresti Tier IV) and the 4th node - Timisoara - still to be completed to Tier IV standard; Giroc node per methodology. Total CPG project ~EUR 370m.

name: SANY International 70 MW data center Timisoara/Uivar
notes: SANY announced plans to fund construction of a 70 MW data center near Timisoara/Uivar as part of a hybrid energy project; planned/announced until official local permits confirm the DC component.

name: SC Class IT Outsourcing SRL - centru de date Alexandria
notes: Per country methodology: Teleorman county ANMAP record for 'centru de asistenta IT international si centru de date' in Alexandria, Str. Turnu Magurele nr. 4, corroborated by Alexandria construction-permit register; specific page not re-fetched in this run, graded C pending re-verification. Teleorman also partner county in Sud-Muntenia regional DC (beneficiary, no separate physical facility).

name: ClusterPower Fauresti (FRS1) - AIC 800 MW AI region site
notes: AIC-ClusterPower JV announced 800 MW AI data-center region across two southwestern sites: Mischii (Dolj, existing MSC1 campus) and Fauresti (Valcea). Fauresti component announced (Dec 2025); needs local permits/grid evidence to confirm stage.

name: Digital Cuisine Ramnicu Valcea data center
notes: Per country methodology: operator EU-project page describes new unit providing data-center services at Str. Gib Mihaescu 31, Ramnicu Valcea; page not re-verified in this run - unverified lead.
